Name: Auto Attack
Author: X3n0n182
Description:
[size=3]DISCLAIMER: WORKS MAINLY ON PC, IDK WHAT WILL HAPPEN IF YOU TRY IT ON OTHER PLATFORMS OR WITH CUSTOM WEAPON MODS[/size]

[b](Works in Stardew Valley Expanded as well and update 1.5. And dw 1.2.1-beta functions as intended!)[/b]

[size=2][size=3][b]Known Issues:[/b][/size]

1. Sword invisible while attacking ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿  ﻿(minor visual issue that doesn't affect functionality).
[/size][size=2]2. Mod not making you swing weapon as much or at all when standing still compared to moving       ﻿(looking into this, not sure what's causing it yet).
3. Enemies in the same tile as the farmer are hidden from the mod ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿ ﻿      (ensure all monsters are kept at distance in the meantime).[/size]

[size=3][b]Installation:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Download file.
[*]Unzip into Mods folder.
[*]Voila!
[*]Delete AutoAttack folder to uninstall.
[/list]
[size=3][b]Usage:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Equip a melee weapon. (Club, Sword, Dagger)
[*]Just run around as you'll automatically aim and attack at the closest monster to you within four tiles, you are able to side-step as well so it makes daggers and clubs a less of a pain to use! Although I recommend Swords or Clubs mainly because they'll be better at dealing with swarms. Still is risky to use a Dagger against groups of stronger monsters that actually deal damage with this mod due to lack of range.
[*]Watch the video showcasing it, I moved my cursor to the top-most left of the screen and didn't left-click at all to show its capabilities.
[/list]

Pls make suggestion on improving it too and what extra stuff y'all might want for it
